engine.magick.description:
JPG, PNG, WEBP, AVIF, HEIC, TIFF, GIF, APNG, PSD, camera RAW and more.
Quality, size and DPI follow your preset.
engine.pdfium.description: Renders PDF pages to PNG, JPG and TIFF (also multi-page TIFF and GIF) at the preset's resolution.
engine.pdfsharp.description: Makes PDFs from images and merges, splits or cuts page ranges out of PDFs.
engine.rhwp.description:
Renders HWP/HWPX to PDF and converts HWP ↔ HWPX.
It also draws documents that reach PDF through HWPX (DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, e-books…).
engine.unhwp.description: Extracts text, Markdown and HTML from HWP and HWPX.
engine.spreadsheet.description:
XLSX, XLS, ODS, CSV and TSV into each other (XLS is read only).
One CSV per sheet.
engine.ooxml.description:
Macro-enabled files and templates (DOCM, XLSM, PPTM, DOTX…) ↔ DOCX, XLSX, PPTX.
Macros are removed.
engine.hwpx-writer.description:
Writes HWPX from Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF, HTML, e-books and Markdown.
The first step of turning documents into PDF without Office.
engine.docx-writer.description: Writes Word documents (DOCX) from PDF, HWP/HWPX, Markdown, HTML, spreadsheets, slides and e-books.
engine.pdf-text.description: Extracts the text of PDFs in reading order, also from two-column pages (no OCR for scans).
engine.email.description:
E-mails (EML, Outlook MSG) to HTML and text with sender, recipients and date, pictures included; attachments into a ZIP.
MSG to EML.
engine.data.description:
JSON, JSON Lines, YAML, TOML, XML and CSV into each other.
vCard contacts to CSV and back.
Comments are dropped. CSV holds tables only.
engine.vector.description: SVG and SVGZ to vector PDF, images and DXF; pictures traced into SVG; Illustrator files saved with PDF content.
engine.icns.description: macOS app icons (ICNS) from and to images.
engine.font.description: Fonts: TTF, OTF, WOFF, WOFF2 and EOT into each other.
engine.cad.description: AutoCAD drawings: DWG ↔ DXF, and both to PDF, SVG and PNG.
engine.model3d.description: 3D models: GLB, glTF, STL, OBJ, 3MF and PLY into each other, and a PNG preview.
engine.archive.description: Extracts ZIP, 7Z, RAR, TAR, ISO and more, and packs ZIP, 7Z or TAR.GZ (7-Zip).
engine.ebook.description:
EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2 and comics (CBZ, CBR) to PDF, EPUB, DOCX and text.
Also documents to EPUB, EPUB to KEPUB for Kobo and PDF to CBZ.
engine.subtitle.description:
Subtitles: SRT, ASS/SSA, WebVTT, SAMI (SMI), LRC, TTML, MicroDVD and SCC into each other, saved as UTF-8.
Korean SMI and SRT files in CP949 / EUC-KR read correctly.
engine.ffmpeg.description:
Video and audio: MP4, MOV, MKV, WEBM, MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC and more.
Also extracts sound and subtitles, makes GIF and APNG animations and saves images as HEIC.
engine.pandoc.description:
Markdown and HTML ↔ ODT and RTF, DOCX → Markdown
reStructuredText, LaTeX, Org, AsciiDoc, Typst, MediaWiki, DocBook, Jupyter and more ↔ Markdown, HTML, DOCX and ODT
Markdown and Org → PPTX slides
engine.ghostscript.description: EPS, PostScript and older Illustrator files to PDF and images; PDF to EPS and PS.
engine.calibre.description: Rare e-book formats (LIT, LRF, CHM, PDB, RB…) and Kindle output (MOBI, AZW3).
engine.libreoffice.description:
Reads older and less common formats: DOC, PPT, Pages, Keynote, Numbers, WordPerfect, ClarisWorks, Publisher, Visio…
Also saves as DOC, XLS, PPT, ODT, ODP, OpenDocument templates and EMF.

Add it again to update it.

Presets set to “Default save location” save here.
A preset with its own location keeps it.
general.keep_dates: Keep the original file dates for every conversion
general.keep_dates_hint:
Converted files keep the original's created and modified dates, with every preset.
Off: only presets with "Keep the original file dates" do it.
general.no_history: Don't keep a history of recent conversions

triggers.title: Shortcuts
triggers.description: Choose how the donut toolbar opens. You can add as many gestures as you like.
triggers.macos_permissions:
Allow Filee in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility.
Finder also asks for Automation permission the first time you use a selection shortcut.
triggers.linux_x11:
Drag gestures work on X11.
With file manager integration on, the first keyboard shortcut runs Thunar's Filee action (reopen Thunar after changing it).
Hold gestures and shortcuts in other file managers aren't available. Use the Filee menu or the drop zone.
triggers.linux_wayland:
Gestures that follow the cursor aren't available on Wayland.
Use an X11 session, or convert with the file manager menu and the drop zone.
Thunar can use the first keyboard shortcut after it restarts.
triggers.hook_stopped:
Global input detection is stopped.
File manager actions and the drop zone remain available.
triggers.excluded_hint: Type an app name and press Enter, e.g. photoshop
triggers.excluded_none_running: No other app has a window open.
triggers.excluded_note: Gestures and shortcuts do nothing while the pointer is over these apps.

presets.title: Presets
presets.name: Name
presets.keep_color_profile_hint:
Available when metadata is removed.
Without it, wide-gamut photos (Display P3 from phones) can look washed out.
presets.remove_background_hint:
Makes a plain background transparent: the paper behind a signature or stamp, the backdrop of a logo.
The colour along the edge counts as background, so leave some paper around the artwork.
JPG has no transparency and gets the colour below. Not for photos of people.
presets.background_tolerance_hint:
Higher removes more, like shaded paper or smudges. Too high thins light strokes.
To keep a light fill inside an outline, turn on "Keep enclosed areas".
presets.keep_enclosed_background_hint:
Removes only the background touching the edge, so the white inside a logo stays.
Leave off for handwriting (it would keep the paper inside letters like "o").
presets.multipage_tiff: Put every file into one multi-page TIFF
presets.multipage_tiff_hint:
Each image and each PDF or TIFF page becomes a page, in order.
One PDF is enough for a multi-page TIFF.
presets.merge: Merge all files into one PDF
presets.combine_pages_hint:
Puts all pages one under another in a single image.
Very long results are scaled to the format's limit (JPG 65,500 px, WebP 16,383 px).
presets.combine_pages: Stack the pages into one tall image (when a PDF is converted)
presets.trim_page_margins: Cut the blank space above and below each page
presets.split_tall_image: Too tall for the format: split into several images
presets.split_tall_image_hint:
Off: a long image is scaled down to the format's limit (JPG 65,500 px, WebP 16,383 px).
On: it keeps its size and is split between pages into several files (name_1, name_2, …).
presets.media_quality_hint:
When the new format can hold the codecs as they are (iPhone MOV → MP4), the video is only rewrapped.
No quality lost, HDR kept, done in seconds.
Small always re-encodes to make the file smaller.
presets.video_codec_hint:
H.264 plays everywhere.
HEVC files are about half the size and play on most phones, TVs and recent PCs.
AV1 is smaller still but slow to encode and needs a recent device.
A video already in the chosen codec is only rewrapped.
presets.combine: Put all files into one archive
presets.extract_note: Each archive is extracted into a folder of its own. Where it goes is set under Output.
presets.trace_note: Used when a picture (PNG, JPG, …) is traced into vector shapes.
presets.trace_detail_hint:
Low smooths the outlines and drops specks.
High follows the pixels closely and keeps small details.
presets.keep_dates_hint: Converted files get the created and modified dates of the original, so photos still sort by date.
presets.delete_confirm: Delete “{0}”? It will also be removed from every toolbar and group.
presets.select: Select a preset to edit it
theme.title: Theme
theme.reduce_motion_hint: Recommended for older PCs. Turns off transitions and the donut's bounce.
engines.title: Conversion engines
engines.description:
Filee picks the best available engine for each conversion.
When several can do the same job, the higher one wins.
engines.optional_description:
Large engines are only downloaded when you want them.
They are kept when Filee updates and removed when you uninstall it.
engines.update_notice_title: Engines you installed have a new version
engines.all_description: Drag a card (or use its arrows) to change the order.
engines.lo_description:
LibreOffice can take over conversions it does more faithfully.
Without LibreOffice these switches change nothing.
engines.lo_slides_hint:
Slide backgrounds and shape positions come out as in PowerPoint.
Off: the built-in route, which can lose backgrounds or move shapes.
engines.lo_documents: Use LibreOffice for Word documents → PDF
engines.lo_documents_hint:
Laid out as in Word, including Chinese and Japanese punctuation rules.
Off: the built-in route.
engines.lo_sheets_hint:
Printed like Excel, with the print area, page setup and page breaks.
Off: the built-in route fits each sheet to the page width (page breaks kept).
engines.lo_hwp_hint:
Off by default: rhwp usually looks more like 한글.
Turn it on to compare when rhwp gets a document wrong (overlapping text, misplaced tables).
engines.package.libreoffice.name: LibreOffice (older and rare formats)
engines.package.libreoffice.description:
Needed for old or uncommon formats: DOC·PPT, OpenDocument presentations, WordPerfect, ClarisWorks·MacWrite, Apple Pages·Numbers·Keynote, Publisher·Visio and more.
Also saves as DOC·XLS·PPT·ODT·ODP·EMF and makes presentations → PDF more faithful.
Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF and HWP convert without it.
engines.package.pandoc.name: Pandoc (Markdown, LaTeX, Org and more)
engines.package.pandoc.description:
Adds Markdown and HTML ↔ ODT and RTF, DOCX → Markdown, and LaTeX, Org, AsciiDoc, Typst, Jupyter and other markup.
Also makes PPTX slides from Markdown.
Markdown and HTML → PDF, DOCX and HWPX work without it.
engines.package.ghostscript.name: Ghostscript (EPS and PostScript)
engines.package.ghostscript.description:
EPS, PS and older Illustrator files → PDF and images, PDF or SVG → EPS/PS.
SVG and PDF-compatible AI files convert without it.
engines.package.ffmpeg.name: FFmpeg (video and audio)
engines.package.ffmpeg.description:
Adds video and audio conversion, video → GIF or still image, sound from videos and GIF → MP4.
Only needed for video and audio.
engines.package.calibre.name: Calibre (Kindle and rare e-book formats)
engines.package.calibre.description:
Saves MOBI and AZW3 for Kindle and converts rare e-book formats (LIT, LRF, PDB, CHM…).
EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2 and comics are read without it.

about.title: About
about.license: Filee is free software under the MIT license.
about.support_text:
Filee is free and open source.
A star on GitHub, a bug report, an idea or a sponsorship all help.
sponsor.title: Sponsor Filee
sponsor.lead: Filee is free and stays free. If you'd like to support its development, pick whichever way suits you.
sponsor.note.github: Monthly or one-time, by card through GitHub
sponsor.note.kofi: A one-time coffee, no account needed
sponsor.star: A ⭐ on GitHub costs nothing and helps other people find Filee.
feedback.notice_text:
A star on GitHub helps other people find Filee.
Problems and ideas are welcome too.
setup.title: Choose conversion engines
setup.description:
Images, PDF, Office documents, HWP, e-books, archives, fonts, CAD and 3D models already convert.
Download engines only for video and audio or rare formats.
setup.note: You can install or remove engines at any time in Settings → Engines.
watch.title: Watch folders
watch.description:
Files that land in these folders are converted while Filee runs.
Downloads and copies wait until they're complete.
watch.originals_keep: Leave the original where it is
watch.originals_hint: Moving originals makes the folder work like an inbox, and files already waiting there when Filee starts are converted too.
watch.include_placeholder: Type an extension or a name, then Enter (e.g. heic, scan_*)
watch.include_hint:
Leave empty to convert every file.
· heic → files ending in .heic
· scan → files with "scan" in the name
· * stands for any text, ? for one character (e.g. scan_*.jpg)
watch.name: Base name
watch.name_hint: The buttons add parts of the name. Leave it empty to use the preset's name.
watch.token.name: Original name
watch.rename_intro:
Set the base name, then change parts of it with rules if needed.
The preview shows the name each file will get.
watch.rename_no_steps: No changes. Pick one on the left or add one if you need it.
watch.rename_try_placeholder: Type a file name, e.g. IMG_0412.jpg
watch.include_matches: {0} file(s) in the folder match now
watch.recipes_hint: Double-click one (or press +) to add it as a rule, then change it if you like.
watch.preview_keep: The original stays where it is
watch.cli_hint: Also on the command line: filee watch <folder> --to <format>
